summary: Implements CorpusCommandService: seven corpus-curation pipelines (salvage, verify, catalog, extract, archive-move, organize, enrich) in one 3150-line file containing the Context.Service contract, live layer, use-case wrappers, DuckDB SQL, filesystem/digest primitives, provenance-manifest loading, docket/patent text parsing, and per-pipeline orchestration.

concerns.name: Service contract + live wiring
concerns.description: CorpusCommandServiceShape interface, CorpusCommandService Context.Service tag, makeCorpusCommandService (context capture + Effect.provide per method), CorpusCommandServiceLive layer.

concerns.name: Public use-case facade
concerns.description: Seven Effect.fn wrappers that yield the service and delegate, plus printCorpusIndex; mostly JSDoc with docgen-run @example blocks importing from @beep/repo-cli/commands/Corpus.

concerns.name: DuckDB SQL + row schemas + db helpers
concerns.description: Raw SQL string constants for four tables/views and six statements, S.Class row models with decode fns, and the generic scoped-layer runner/insert/single-row helpers.

concerns.name: Filesystem/digest/JSONL primitives
concerns.description: Command-agnostic plumbing: streaming sha256, fail-closed path resolution wrapper, JSONL join/append, mkdir+write, path-segment validation, mtime extraction, sha256 dedupe.

concerns.name: Provenance manifest discovery + digest index
concerns.description: Decoding provenance JSONL, discovering base/run manifests under raw/, and building the sha256->destPath dedupe index from DuckDB catalog or raw manifests.

concerns.name: Catalog pipeline
concerns.description: catalogCorpusImpl: unions run manifests into catalog records, pairs recycle-bin entries into restoration records, builds the DuckDB catalog, and writes duplicate-set/summary reports.

concerns.name: Extraction pipeline
concerns.description: extractCorpusImpl: wires libpff/Tika engines into a FileProcessingService layer, maps ProcessFileOperation results into outcome records via exhaustive match, and writes run/coverage/sources/failures artifacts.

concerns.name: Salvage + verify pipeline
concerns.description: Recursive source-file collection, sequential copy-with-digest-verify into raw/ with optional dedupe against the digest index, and strided re-hash verification with report writing.

concerns.name: Archive-move pipeline
concerns.description: archiveMoveImpl: provenance-coverage index, per-file digest validation with typed archive-move errors, destination-conflict planning, and EXDEV-aware move (rename or copy-verify-remove).

concerns.name: Organize taxonomy + pure parsing
concerns.description: Docket regex parsing (exported extractCorpusDocket), Windows-path/version-stem normalization, category assignment, version indexing, target dedupe, copy/symlink materialization, and the organized DuckDB table.

concerns.name: USPTO enrichment pipeline
concerns.description: enrichCorpusImpl: patent/application regex candidate collection from names and extracted text, rate-limited sequential Uspto lookups with continuity fetch, enrichment manifest + DuckDB table.

concerns.name: Console progress rendering
concerns.description: ~20 inline Console.log progress/summary lines interleaved through every impl (e.g. per-250 extract progress, per-run catalog counts); small enough that a Corpus.render.ts is not yet earned.

proposedSplit.contents: Keep only CorpusCommandServiceShape, the CorpusCommandService tag, makeCorpusCommandService (importing the seven *Impl fns from internal/), CorpusCommandServiceLive, the seven use-case wrappers, and printCorpusIndex; re-export extractCorpusDocket from internal/Docket.js to preserve the public facade. (~500 LOC)

Command-agnostic primitives used by 2+ pipelines: hashFileSha256, resolveWithinRoot, writeCorpusStringFile, jsonlContent, appendCorpusJsonLines, basenameOf, parentDirOf, extensionOf, isSafePathSegment, validatePathSegment, fileMtimeFields, dedupeBySha256, labelPathKey, sanitizeSegment, plus the shared decode consts (decodePosixPath, decodeSha256Hex, decodeSha256FromBytes).

Generic DuckDB machinery: runWithCorpusDb (scoped Layer.build runner mapped into CorpusCommandError), insertRows, singleRow, sqlStringLiteral. Pipeline-specific SQL constants stay with their pipeline module.

Provenance manifest domain: decodeProvenanceLines, CatalogManifest, baseCatalogRunLabel, catalogCopyModeFor, catalogDigestPathKey, discoverCatalogManifests, findRawProvenanceManifests, loadManifestDigestRows, loadCatalogDigestRows, loadSalvageDigestIndex, addDigestRows.

Pure text parsers: docketPattern, docketFamilyPattern, pipeDocket, the exported extractCorpusDocket (re-exported through Corpus.service.ts so the facade export and its docgen example keep working), windowsPathDirectories, versionStem.

catalogCorpusImpl plus its private cluster: catalog SQL statements (createSourceFilesTable, createDuplicateSetsView, createRestorationsTable, totals/rows statements), SourceTotalsRow/DuplicateTotalsRow classes and decoders, restorationToRow, buildCatalogRunSummaries, buildRestorationRecords.

extractCorpusImpl plus extractCoverageFormats, engineFamilyFromName, deriveCorpusOperationId, CorpusExtractOutcome, failedOutcome, prepareExtractOutputDir, selectExtractRecords, buildExtractCoverage, and the artifact/digest/operation/source-artifact decode consts; processOneSource stays a closure inside the impl (it captures outDir, completedRef, total).

archiveMoveImpl plus ArchiveProvenanceMatch/ArchiveValidatedFile, zeroSha256, archiveRawRootForProvenance, archiveCopyModeFor, referencedRawPathForArchive, collectArchiveSourceFiles, loadArchiveProvenanceIndex, digestMismatch, validateArchiveFile, isCrossDeviceRename, copyVerifyAndRemoveFile, moveSourceAcrossDevice, moveArchiveSource.

organizeCorpusImpl plus OrganizePlanRow, prepareOrganizedRoot, loadMatchedRestorations, loadClientMap, organizeCategoryFor, planOrganizeRow, buildOrganizePlan, assignVersionIndexes, organizedRelativeFor, dedupeOrganizedTarget, materializeOrganizedRow, organizeRecordFor, buildOrganizeSummary, createOrganizedTable/insertOrganizedStatement, writeOrganizedTable, decodeRestorationRecordJson, decodeClientMapJson.

enrichCorpusImpl plus patentTextPattern, applicationTextPattern, EnrichCandidate, EnrichCandidateCollector, makeEnrichCandidateCollector, loadEnrichOrganizeRecords, buildFamilyByTextName, buildEnrichSummary, createEnrichmentTable/insertEnrichmentStatement.

sharedCandidates.description: Scoped DuckDb Layer.build + provide + error-map runner. Research/internal/Catalog.ts (lines 69-75) already reimplements exactly this pattern; a generic withDuckDb(databasePath) belongs in src/internal/ or @beep/duckdb itself.
Streaming node:crypto sha256 of a file via fs.stream. Files.service.ts:2714 has a verbatim duplicate (Files.hashFileSha256).
Generic DuckDB parameterized batch insert and exactly-one-row decode guard; pairs with runWithCorpusDb for any group writing DuckDB catalogs.
JSONL join-with-trailing-newline and append-with-fsync manifest writer; generic once the CorpusCommandError mapping is parameterized. Candidate for src/internal/cli/ next to Json.ts.

Fail-closed wrapper around @beep/file-processing/PathSafety resolvePathWithinRoot that maps into a command error with a label. Yeet/internal/Handler.ts, Yeet/internal/FallowFeedback.ts, Quality/internal/QualityArtifactSupport.ts, and Image.service.ts all call resolvePathWithinRoot and likely repeat this error-mapping shape.
Order-preserving first-wins dedupe over records keyed by sha256 returning kept + skipped count; generic content-addressed dedupe.
Single-path-segment guard (no '/', '\\', '.', '..'); useful anywhere user-supplied labels become directory names.
FileSystem.File.Info mtime Option to {mtimeEpoch, mtimeIso} with epoch-zero fallback, using effect DateTime.

risks: Facade breakage: commands/Corpus/index.ts does `export *` from Corpus.service.ts and test/corpus-command.test.ts imports CorpusCommandServiceLive, catalogCorpus, extractCorpus, salvageCorpus, verifySalvage, archiveMoveCorpus via @beep/repo-cli/commands/Corpus — every currently exported service symbol (including extractCorpusDocket and printCorpusIndex) must remain re-exported from Corpus.service.ts or index.ts after the split.

extractCorpusDocket is a public, JSDoc-documented export whose @example imports from @beep/repo-cli/commands/Corpus; moving it to internal/ without a facade re-export breaks docgen example compilation and the jsdoc-categories test; internal files also still need @example/@category/@since on exported symbols for docgen.

$I identity strings: $RepoCliId.create("commands/Corpus/Corpus.service") prefixes the S.Class ids for SourceTotalsRow, DuplicateTotalsRow, CatalogManifest; per-file $I in new internal modules changes schema identifiers, which the generated tracked schema catalog (P3, commit 5783560) and schema-catalog/schema-topology tests will notice — regenerate the catalog or keep identifier strings stable.

Ordering/state coupling: salvageCorpusImpl mutates the shared digestIndex during sequential (concurrency:1) processing so dedupe depends on file order; extract's processOneSource closes over completedRef/outDir/total; archiveMove's usedArchiveTargets accumulates across plans — extracting these closures to top-level functions with wider signatures must not change concurrency or evaluation order.

Error-channel drift: archive-move helpers return CorpusArchiveMoveError (union incl. CorpusCommandError) while everything else returns CorpusCommandError; splitting modules invites accidental widening/narrowing of Effect.fn.Return annotations that dtslint/check will flag across the seven Impl signatures.

Import cycles: internal pipeline modules must import only Corpus.errors/Corpus.schemas/Corpus.recyclebin and the new internal Shared/CorpusDb/Provenance modules — never Corpus.service.ts — or the service-to-impl import direction creates a cycle; also keep makeCorpusCommandService's Effect.context<CorpusCommandServiceRequirements>() capture in the service file so layer requirements stay unchanged.

summary: Pure <Group>.schemas.ts role file: 30+ S.Class models, 6 LiteralKit literal domains, one tagged union, and 13 derived JSON/JSONL codecs (S.encodeUnknownEffect(S.fromJsonString(...))) for the corpus command suite. It is not mixed-responsibility by role — its 1574 lines (roughly half JSDoc @example blocks) come from packing schemas for seven distinct subcommand domains (salvage, catalog, recycle-bin restoration, extract, organize, enrich, archive-move) into one file.

concerns.name: Salvage & provenance schemas
concerns.description: Core salvage-run models: copy disposition, digest rows, the JSONL provenance record with decode/encode codecs, source specs, origin files, salvage options and summary. Base cluster that the catalog cluster depends on (CorpusCopyMode, CorpusProvenanceRecord shape).

concerns.name: Catalog schemas
concerns.description: DuckDB catalog models: duplicate scope, unioned source-file record, duplicate-set report rows, catalog options, per-run and overall summaries plus their JSON codecs. Imports CorpusCopyMode from the salvage cluster (one-directional).

concerns.name: Windows recycle-bin restoration schemas
concerns.description: Self-contained $I/$R forensics domain: format version, recovered original facts, the three-variant matchStatus tagged union of restoration records with JSONL codec, and the scan/pair/pairing models consumed by Corpus.recyclebin.ts parsing helpers. Zero coupling to the other clusters.

concerns.name: Extract schemas
concerns.description: Tika/pffexport extraction options and summary counts with JSON codec. Standalone cluster.

concerns.name: Organize schemas
concerns.description: Taxonomy category literal domain, organize manifest row, options, and summary with JSONL/JSON codecs. Standalone cluster.

concerns.name: Enrich (USPTO) schemas
concerns.description: USPTO identifier enrichment options, manifest record (with two anonymous inline LiteralKit domains for candidateKind and status), and summary with codecs. Standalone cluster.

concerns.name: Archive-move schemas
concerns.description: Archive-move options, per-source manifest record with JSONL codec, and summary counts. Standalone cluster.

concerns.name: Repeated JSONL codec boilerplate
concerns.description: Thirteen near-identical `S.encodeUnknownEffect(S.fromJsonString(X))` / decode consts, each with a 20-30-line JSDoc example; the mechanical pattern itself is ~40 LOC of code but drives several hundred lines of doc weight. Correctly colocated with their schemas today.

proposedSplit.contents: CorpusCopyMode, CorpusCatalogDigestRow, CorpusProvenanceRecord + decode/encode JSONL codecs, CorpusSalvageSourceSpec, CorpusSalvageOriginFile, CorpusSalvageOptions, CorpusSalvageSummary + codec. Base module the Catalog module imports CorpusCopyMode/record shape from.

CorpusDuplicateScope, CorpusCatalogSourceFileRecord + codec, CorpusDuplicateSetRecord + report codec, CorpusCatalogOptions, CorpusCatalogRunSummary, CorpusCatalogSummary + codec; imports CorpusCopyMode from Salvage.schemas.

RecycleBinFormatVersion, RecycleBinOriginal, MatchedRestorationRecord, UnmatchedMetadataRestorationRecord, UnmatchedContentRestorationRecord, CorpusRestorationRecord tagged union + codec, RecycleBinEntryKind, RecycleBinScanEntry, RecycleBinPairedEntry, RecycleBinPairing. Natural partner to the existing Corpus.recyclebin.ts parsing helpers, which import exactly these.
CorpusOrganizeOptions, CorpusOrganizeCategory, CorpusOrganizeRecord + codec, CorpusOrganizeSummary + codec.

CorpusEnrichOptions, CorpusEnrichmentRecord + codec, CorpusEnrichSummary + codec; opportunity to name the two anonymous inline LiteralKit domains (candidateKind, status) as exported building blocks per repo law.

Becomes the canonical-role facade: re-exports the seven internal schema modules so index.ts's `export * from "./Corpus.schemas.js"`, all deep imports in Corpus.service.ts/Corpus.command.ts/Corpus.recyclebin.ts, and test imports via @beep/repo-cli/commands/Corpus keep resolving unchanged. internal/ precedent already exists in 8 sibling groups (Yeet, Quality, Docgen, Research, ...).

sharedCandidates.helper: JSONL/JSON codec factory (e.g. JsonStringCodec(schema) -> { decode, encode })
sharedCandidates.description: The `S.encodeUnknownEffect(S.fromJsonString(X))` / `S.decodeUnknownEffect(S.fromJsonString(X))` pair is instantiated 13 times in this file alone, and `fromJsonString` appears in 16 other command files in this CLI. A tiny shared helper (in a package-level shared module or @beep/schema) would collapse the boilerplate.

Windows Recycle Bin $I/$R forensics (format versions, FILETIME decode, pairing) is generic file-forensics domain knowledge, not corpus-curation-specific; a future home could be @beep/file-processing or a Files-group utility. Currently only Corpus uses it, so promotion is speculative — keep command-local for now.

risks: Schema identity churn: $I = $RepoCliId.create("commands/Corpus/Corpus.schemas") bakes the module path into every schema identifier/annotation. New internal modules with new create() paths change identifiers, which will drift the tracked generated schema catalog (P3, commit 5783560) and anything keying on schema ids — either preserve the identity strings or regenerate/commit the catalog and expect `bun run beep lint` schema-catalog churn.

Public facade breakage: src/commands/Corpus/index.ts does `export * from "./Corpus.schemas.js"` and test/corpus-command.test.ts imports CorpusProvenanceRecord, RecycleBinScanEntry, and codecs via @beep/repo-cli/commands/Corpus; Corpus.schemas.ts must remain a re-export facade (or index.ts must add the internal modules) so all 40+ symbols keep resolving.

Deep-import fan-out: Corpus.service.ts (3150 lines) imports 35 value + 8 type symbols and Corpus.command.ts/Corpus.recyclebin.ts import from ./Corpus.schemas.js directly; either keep those paths valid via the barrel or update three large import blocks — a mechanical but wide diff prone to merge conflicts with the in-flight repo-cli-modularization branch (Corpus.recyclebin.ts is already dirty in git status).

Docgen: every export carries compiled @example blocks importing from "@beep/repo-cli/commands/Corpus"; moved code must keep those examples type-valid (run bun run docgen:local), and the moved JSDoc must retain @category/@since to pass jsdoc lint.

export * collision risk: the barrel re-exporting seven internal modules must not introduce duplicate exported names (none exist today, e.g. CorpusCopyMode is defined once), and internal modules must import CorpusCopyMode from Salvage.schemas rather than redefining it, or the tagged-union/annotation identity changes.

Ordering/coupling seam: Catalog.schemas depends on Salvage.schemas (CorpusCopyMode; CorpusCatalogSourceFileRecord mirrors CorpusProvenanceRecord fields by duplication, not composition) — keep the dependency one-directional and resist 'composing' the record shapes during the move, which would change encoded output.
